results.title: 1st confirmed Ebola patient in Nigeria evacuated to Switzerland | PBS News
results.snippet:
Nigerian Health Minister Muhammad Pate said the woman, the country's first case in the current outbreak, left the capital, Abuja, early Monday with his approval. Her condition had improved significantly, and she was stable, conscious and able to communicate, he said.

results.title: Nigeria’s Ebola Patient Evacuated as Investigators Press for Answers - The New York Times
results.snippet:
The first case was a 42-year-old Ugandan woman living in Abuja, Nigeria’s capital, with her husband, a Swiss diplomat. She tested positive for the virus last week and was evacuated to Switzerland on Monday in stable condition.

It remains unclear where and how the patient was infected with Ebola. But she was in the Nigerian capital for 17 days before she tested positive for the virus. [...] Suppor
